fields.summary: No owner was present: the conductor planned change set 01M7NVMD under the autonomous rules from the landed milestone-40 Decision m40-host-limits-as-holds (owner: 'Yes that makes sense to me.') and a reading of the code. Findings: a session's process tree is rooted at the 'rhiza session run <session-id>' process (the agent, e.g. claude --session-id, is its child), so ps -A -o pid=,ppid=,rss=,args= finds it on Linux and macOS alike (rss in KiB on both; internal/quiettest already reads ps, not /proc, for that reason). The watchdog's stalled-step pass (internal/api/daemon_watchdog.go, watchdogStalled) already nudges the step's stall sessions (stallSessions: open spawned children counted) and closes panes and terminates the run; only the engine journals a stopped entry today. Watchdog settings live in watchdogNames (internal/api/watchdog_policy.go) with machine and project keys; size values parse with daemon.ParseSize like rhiza.daemon.minTmpFree. Choices made by the planner, no owner asked: three new watchdog keys (runawayProcs default 400, runawayMemory default 8G, runawayGrace default 5m, 0 turning a threshold off); a runaway session is nudged once with the reading, and if a poll at least the grace later still reads it over a threshold the watchdog closes the stall sessions' panes, terminates the run and journals the step stopped with the reading as its detail, without resuming or retrying it (a retry would rerun the same runaway), filing a bug when fileBugs is on; attended runs under autonomousOnly get a log line only, like stalls; tests never read the host's process table.
fields.title: Planning pass for the watchdog's runaway sessions (autonomous conduct run)
